preparations.speaker: serene
preparations.text: They're here. Caelan, would you meet them by the lower bridge? Bring them in when they're ready.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: Regent Aldric? Mother Serene sent me. I’m Caelan.

arrival.speaker: aldric
arrival.text: Thank you, Caelan. Have we kept her waiting?

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: We’ve just finished setting the table.

arrival.speaker: aldric
arrival.text: Then we’ve arrived at a very good moment.

arrival.speaker: aldric
arrival.text: *glances back with a tired smile* Yes. I heard that.

arrival.speaker: aldric
arrival.text: This is Lucan Rooke, my guard. Lucan, Caelan is showing us in.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: Yes. Then through the hall to the dining room.

arrival.speaker: caelan
arrival.text: Mira made it. She gave it to me this morning.

arrival.speaker: lucan
arrival.text: Keep it clear of the gatepost. You’re wearing it wider than you think.

welcome.speaker: serene
welcome.text: You look as though you could use something warm.

welcome.speaker: aldric
welcome.text: I could use several things. That’s comfortably first.

welcome.speaker: serene
welcome.text: Caelan, would you pass the bread?

welcome.speaker: tomas
welcome.text: Were you working the brake coming down the ridge?

welcome.speaker: tomas
welcome.text: How do you stop the wagon getting ahead of the horses?

welcome.speaker: regent_driver
welcome.text: Keep it slow before it starts. Once a loaded wagon’s running, you’ve left yourself very little to work with.

welcome.speaker: tomas
welcome.text: Does the brake press against both wheels?

welcome.speaker: caelan
welcome.text: *slides the bread toward him* You were going to make sure everyone remembered to eat.

welcome.speaker: tomas
welcome.text: I can ask while I’m eating.

welcome.speaker: lucan
welcome.text: His lordship chose me because I can manage both.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: Thank you for the wonderful meal and company. Now if I may, shall we discuss the matter of our visit?

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: Of course. Caelan, please take these plates.

discussion.speaker: caelan
discussion.text: I’ve got them.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: Elden Vale Sanctuary is the closest untapped deposit. We would not ask if it were not important.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: What about the other quarries?

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: They are already mined day and night, but we can't keep up with the demand. The same thing that happened here to the bridge is happening across Merovar.

discussion.speaker: tomas
discussion.text: Couldn’t the crown send more?

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: Would that she could, but alas.

discussion.speaker: tomas
discussion.text: Aren't you Her Majesty's brother? Why would she say no?

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: People haven’t been refusing me, Tomas. They still have to cut the stone and bring it. There are other communities waiting for the same loads.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: A nearer source would give us more room to work. The proposed face is clear of the standing sanctuary walls.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: The protected ground extends beyond those walls.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: I know. I believe we can preserve the place while mining the deposit. I wouldn’t have brought you the proposal otherwise.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: The Sanctuary was built beside that confluence to guide the region’s dead back to the planet. That is the caretakers’ first responsibility.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: People come there to remember them, too. The grove and the ground around it are held for that care.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: Could that work continue if we kept the crews away from the hall and grove?

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: The ground you propose to mine is part of the place we need to keep. Working it would disrupt our duty to the dead.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: And there are living people waiting for these roads.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: Their families depend on us for this as well.

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: There is also a danger your survey does not show. The caretakers have heard growling inside the cave.

discussion.speaker: aldric
discussion.text: Since when?

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: Since the incident at the bridge. They closed the entrance and have been keeping people away.

discussion.speaker: lucan
discussion.text: Has anyone been hurt?

discussion.speaker: serene
discussion.text: None that the caretakers have reported. I want the entrance left alone while they find out what is inside.

attack_report.speaker: regent_survivor
attack_report.text: *breathless* Your lordship—the men at the Sanctuary…

attack_report.speaker: aldric
attack_report.text: What happened?

attack_report.speaker: regent_survivor
attack_report.text: Something came out of the cave. We couldn’t get everyone away.

attack_report.speaker: lucan
attack_report.text: How many are still there?

attack_report.speaker: regent_survivor
attack_report.text: I don’t know. I saw men trying to get clear. Others were still up there when I ran.

attack_report.speaker: serene
attack_report.text: What men?

attack_report.speaker: regent_survivor
attack_report.text: The advance party. We were setting out the Crown’s working ground.

attack_report.speaker: serene
attack_report.text: *turns to Aldric* You sent a crew into the reserve?

attack_report.speaker: aldric
attack_report.text: I sent them ahead to establish the Crown’s authority over the deposit.

attack_report.speaker: serene
attack_report.text: When?

attack_report.speaker: aldric
attack_report.text: Before I came to Eldenmere.

attack_report.speaker: lucan
attack_report.text: *stares at Aldric* You sent men ahead? I wasn't told.

attack_report.speaker: aldric
attack_report.text: It was a separate order, Lucan.

attack_report.speaker: serene
attack_report.text: You came here asking for my agreement after sending them in.

attack_report.speaker: aldric
attack_report.text: There are repair crews waiting. I intended to have the site ready.

attack_report.speaker: serene
attack_report.text: What were your men instructed to do when the caretakers objected?

attack_report.speaker: aldric
attack_report.text: They carried my orders to secure the ground and prepare the mining work.

attack_report.speaker: regent_survivor
attack_report.text: *struggles to catch his breath* My lord, please. They’re still there.

attack_report.speaker: lucan
attack_report.text: Is the road to the reserve clear?

attack_report.speaker: regent_survivor
attack_report.text: It was when I left. I heard it behind us. That growling…

attack_report.speaker: lucan
attack_report.text: *after a moment* We need to reach them.

attack_report.speaker: aldric
attack_report.text: Then we’ll go now.

departure.speaker: serene
departure.text: And clean cloths, please. I need to see where he is hurt.

departure.speaker: regent_driver
departure.text: I’ll help. Tell me what you need.

departure.speaker: caelan
departure.text: I can go with them. Mira has her kit. We can help bring people back.

departure.speaker: serene
departure.text: Get Mira, then find the caretakers. Help the wounded. Keep clear of the cave.

departure.speaker: lucan
departure.text: We stay together on the road. When we arrive, I want to know where everyone is.

departure.speaker: serene
departure.text: Aldric. We have not finished this.

mira_departure.speaker: caelan
mira_departure.text: A crew’s been attacked at the Sanctuary. There are still people up there.

mira_departure.speaker: mira
mira_departure.text: *sets down her tools* Attacked by what?

mira_departure.speaker: lucan
mira_departure.text: Something from the cave. The man who reached us couldn’t give a clear account.

mira_departure.speaker: mira
mira_departure.text: Then I’m coming. Give me a moment.

mira_departure.speaker: mira
mira_departure.text: My kit’s ready. The arm brace will help if anything needs shifting.

mira_departure.speaker: lucan
mira_departure.text: Keep the equipment you need close. We move together.

sanctuary_waiting.speaker: lucan
sanctuary_waiting.text: We’re here. Keep together while we get our bearings.

aftermath.speaker: caelan
aftermath.text: *quietly* He looked relieved when you offered the stone.

aftermath.speaker: serene
aftermath.text: There are people waiting for it.

aftermath.speaker: caelan
aftermath.text: I thought that might settle things for a while.

aftermath.speaker: serene
aftermath.text: It settles what we can give him today.

aftermath.speaker: caelan
aftermath.text: And he’ll ask about the quarry again.

aftermath.speaker: tomas
aftermath.text: Caelan? When you’re finished, can you come and look at the lanterns?

aftermath.speaker: tomas
aftermath.text: Nothing. I want to show you.

aftermath.speaker: serene
aftermath.text: Go on. I have a letter to write.

preparations_after.speaker: serene
preparations_after.text: Everything’s ready here. You’ll find the visitors by the lower bridge.

arrival_reminder.speaker: aldric
arrival_reminder.text: Lead the way, Caelan. I'll follow you.

hospitality_after.speaker: tomas
hospitality_after.text: Do you think he’d show me the brake once he’s finished?

aldric_after.speaker: aldric
aldric_after.text: Thank you for bringing us here, Caelan. I'll see you at the festival.

serene_after.speaker: serene
serene_after.text: I have a letter to write. Tomas could use your help with the lanterns.

driver_after.speaker: regent_driver
driver_after.text: If you're looking at the brake, keep your fingers clear of the catch. It closes harder than it looks.

clerk_after.speaker: regent_clerk
clerk_after.text: I’ll make sure the engineer receives Mother Serene’s copies.

clerk_waiting.speaker: regent_clerk
clerk_waiting.text: I’ll wait until his lordship has finished.

tomas_waiting.speaker: tomas
tomas_waiting.text: Everything’s ready. I hope they’re hungry.

arrival_waiting.speaker: aldric
arrival_waiting.text: Mother Serene is expecting us. We'll wait here until she's ready.

lucan_waiting.speaker: lucan
lucan_waiting.text: The regent is expected inside. Are you taking us in?

arrival_unarmed.speaker: caelan
arrival_unarmed.text: Regent Aldric? Mother Serene sent me. I’m Caelan.

arrival_unarmed.speaker: aldric
arrival_unarmed.text: Thank you, Caelan. Have we kept her waiting?

arrival_unarmed.speaker: aldric
arrival_unarmed.text: Then we’ve arrived at a very good moment.

arrival_unarmed.speaker: aldric
arrival_unarmed.text: *glances back with a tired smile* Yes. I heard that.

arrival_unarmed.speaker: aldric
arrival_unarmed.text: This is Lucan Rooke, my guard. Lucan, Caelan is showing us in.

arrival_unarmed.speaker: caelan
arrival_unarmed.text: Yes. Then through the hall to the dining room.

arrival_before_homecoming.speaker: caelan
arrival_before_homecoming.text: Regent Aldric? Mother Serene sent me. I’m Caelan.

arrival_before_homecoming.speaker: aldric
arrival_before_homecoming.text: Thank you, Caelan. Have we kept her waiting?

arrival_before_homecoming.speaker: aldric
arrival_before_homecoming.text: Then we’ve arrived at a very good moment.

arrival_before_homecoming.speaker: aldric
arrival_before_homecoming.text: *glances back with a tired smile* Yes. I heard that.

arrival_before_homecoming.speaker: aldric
arrival_before_homecoming.text: This is Lucan Rooke, my guard. Lucan, Caelan is showing us in.

arrival_before_homecoming.speaker: caelan
arrival_before_homecoming.text: Yes. Then through the hall to the dining room.

arrival_before_homecoming.speaker: caelan
arrival_before_homecoming.text: Mira made it. She gave it to me this morning.

arrival_before_homecoming.speaker: lucan
arrival_before_homecoming.text: Keep it clear of the gatepost. You’re wearing it wider than you think.

emergency_serene.speaker: serene
emergency_serene.text: I’ll stay with him. Get Mira and reach the caretakers. Keep clear of the cave.

emergency_driver.speaker: regent_driver
emergency_driver.text: I’ll help Mother Serene here. Go on.

emergency_tomas.speaker: tomas
emergency_tomas.text: I’ve got the cloths. Go and find them, Caelan.

travel_aldric.speaker: aldric
travel_aldric.text: We need to reach the people still at the Sanctuary.

travel_lucan.speaker: lucan
travel_lucan.text: Stay with us, Caelan. We don’t know what is waiting at the cave.

travel_page.speaker: regent_clerk
travel_page.text: I have the survey. I’ll keep up.

arrival_aldric_waiting.speaker: aldric
arrival_aldric_waiting.text: We’re accounting for everyone. Bring word as soon as you find him.

arrival_page_waiting.speaker: regent_clerk
arrival_page_waiting.text: I’m checking the crew list with the caretakers. We’ll have their names ready.
